## Floatick v0.5.0

### 中文

- 新增剪贴板历史：自动保存文字剪贴板内容、记录时间、支持搜索和收藏筛选。
- 普通剪贴板记录默认保留 7 天并自动清理，收藏记录会永久本地保存。
- 新增三种悬浮展示模式：悬浮窗常驻、悬浮球常驻、临时展示。
- 悬浮窗和悬浮球支持拖动，并限制至少一半留在屏幕内。
- 优化 macOS 透明窗口背景与圆角裁剪，移除直角灰底。
- 将悬浮球调整为 48x48px 单层圆形图标，并统一应用、托盘和窗口内图标风格。
- 代办列表展示备注摘要，富文本编辑器空内容点击时也能正确显示光标。

### English

- Added clipboard history for text content with timestamps, search, and favorite filtering.
- Regular clipboard entries are retained for 7 days by default; favorites are kept permanently.
- Added three floating presentation modes: persistent panel, persistent floating ball, and transient display.
- Floating panel and ball are draggable and constrained so at least half remains on screen.
- Improved macOS transparent window backgrounds and rounded clipping to remove square gray artifacts.
- Changed the floating ball to a 48x48px single-layer circular icon and unified app, tray, and in-window icon styling.
- Todo rows now show note previews, and the rich text editor shows the caret correctly when empty.
